widgets_values: A widescreen futuristic idol profile poster fills the frame, designed like a sci-fi concert character card with a dark navy-black stage background, electric violet neon accents, translucent interface panels, and cinematic lighting. In the upper-left corner, small widely spaced uppercase lettering reads "CHARACTER CARD" in pale lavender-gray, functioning as a header label. Below it, the dominant main title "LUMINARA" appears in very large, elegant serif capitals with a soft bluish-purple glow and subtle metallic texture; directly underneath, the subtitle "STAR SINGER" is set in smaller widely spaced uppercase letters in muted gray-lavender. Beneath the title area, thin horizontal decorative divider lines extend across the left profile panel, including short pale segments and tiny diamond-like markers that reinforce the high-tech dossier layout. The profile data block on the left uses aligned label-and-value typography: the label "NAME /" appears above the value "LUMINARA星澜", with the Chinese name in slightly brighter lavender; below it, "TITLE /" is paired with "FUTURE IDOL"; farther down, "AGE /" is paired with "21"; then "HEIGHT /" is paired with "169cm"; and "BIRTHDAY /" is paired with "07/21". All of these left-side labels are in condensed uppercase sans-serif styling, muted gray-blue, while the values sit to the right of the slash separators in a slightly larger pale lavender-gray typeface. Below the basic information, a horizontal attributes section contains five small square rounded-corner icon tiles with thin violet outlines and dark translucent interiors: the first shows a faceted diamond symbol, the second a stylized flame or winged crest, the third a starburst or compass-like emblem, the fourth a music note, and the fifth a circular orbital glyph. To the right of these icons are numeric ratings separated by diagonal slash dividers, reading "4.8 / 3.6 / 4.9 / 4.7 / 4.6" in small pale text; each icon is aligned with its corresponding score. Along the bottom-left corner, a large angular wing-shaped emblem appears in semi-transparent violet and silver, resembling a sharp futuristic crest or stylized letterform; beside it, the slogan "FUTURE IS OUR SONG" is written in spaced uppercase letters in pale lavender-gray. The central and right side of the composition is dominated by a realistic close-up performance portrait of a young adult woman idol singer with fair skin, an East Asian appearance, an oval face, soft brows, defined eyeliner, long lashes, glossy rose-pink lipstick, subtle blush, and luminous stage makeup that catches blue and violet highlights. Her dark brown to black hair is loosely swept back with damp-looking strands framing her face; she wears crystalline metallic earrings, delicate necklaces, and intricate star-and-chain head accessories with dangling translucent pieces. She is dressed in a transparent iridescent futuristic stage costume with reflective plastic-like panels, silver chain details, angular rhinestone ornaments, dark mesh straps, sequins, and spiked crystalline shoulder armor. Her expression is focused and calm, eyes directed toward the viewer or audience, while she holds a black handheld microphone close to her mouth in her right hand. Her left arm reaches forward toward the camera, creating strong depth of field: her extended hand and fingers are large, soft, and blurred in the foreground, emphasizing an intimate concert-performance perspective. The environment behind her resembles a futuristic indoor arena or sci-fi concert hall, with towering dark architectural panels, glowing blue and purple light strips, circular luminous ring structures behind her head and shoulder area, suspended stage equipment, lens flares, cool haze, and diagonal beams of spotlight cutting through the scene. In the lower-right background, a crowd appears as dark silhouettes with raised arms and small glowing light sticks, partially obscured by darkness and blue-violet illumination. Along the right edge, a narrow translucent vertical information panel with thin violet borders and angular sci-fi corner decorations overlays the stage background. Inside this panel, stacked uppercase text blocks appear in muted lavender-gray: "LIVE PERFORMANCE" near the upper section, then "INTERSTELLAR TOUR 07", followed by "GALACTIC ARENA - SECTOR 9", and lower down the date-like line "2087 / 07 / 21". The panel uses fine outline borders, diagonal decorative strokes, small rectangular ticks, and faint grid-like detailing, giving it the look of an augmented-reality concert data card. The overall image is a polished promotional character sheet combining fashion photography, sci-fi interface design, idol concert advertising, and cinematic digital art, with a cool palette of black, midnight blue, icy cyan, violet, and silver.
